description: Ordinance-flow draft-step cases. Each names a captured fixture record; the producer seeds that record's prior-step state and drives the draft turn. The draft step is chosen because it synthesises from already-hydrated prior-step data instead of researching live, so two variants answer the same question rather than racing the open web.

cases.label: Shade trees — new ordinance from a policy goal

Bike parking redraft — amends existing law, expects redline
